changes.before: And now the Empress Dowager, overcome with indignation, has suddenly passed away.
changes.after: Matters came to the point that the Empress Dowager, overcome with indignation, suddenly passed away.
changes.reason: 至今 here continues the causal chain from 遂致敗國: Yu Liang's conduct led to the revolt and then to the Empress Dowager's indignant death. That death is dated AD 328 (Jinshu 7: 咸和三年三月丙子，皇太后庾氏崩). 'And now ... has suddenly passed away' wrongly presents it as a fresh death at the time of the AD 340–341 memorial.
changes.sourceQuote: 至今太后發憤，一旦升遐。
